item.title: More than a game: Huston-Tillotson basketball building toward the future
item.description: Huston‑Tillotson head coach John A. Smith is building a family‑centered basketball culture rooted in education, community and resilience. As the Rams prepare to join the HBCU Athletic Conference, the university is also transforming thanks to a historic $150 million Moody gift that will expand scholarships, facilities and opportunities for student‑athletes.

item.title: How Steve Sarkisian is adapting his culture-building to 'the modern athlete today'
item.description: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian is reworking his approach to culture‑building as the Longhorns prepare for spring practice, saying he waited too long last season to establish expectations with a roster full of early enrollees and transfers.

item.title: 'Multiple explosions,' fires cause homeless camp concerns in Austin
item.description: The Austin Fire Department described "multiple explosions" and 15-foot high flames sparked by "encampment activity" on Dec. 30, according to the incident report -- one of hundreds of fires a KXAN investigation found likely connected to homeless encampments in recent months.

item.title: Arch Manning will have 'plenty of time' to develop chemistry with new WRs after offseason surgery
item.description: Texas quarterback Arch Manning and several key Longhorns underwent offseason surgeries, but Steve Sarkisian says all are expected to be fully cleared by fall camp as spring practice nears.

item.title: Texas governor orders DPS 'surge' to border region after cartel leader killed
item.description: Gov. Greg Abbott said in his press release that cartels pose a "significant threat to public safety and national security."

item.title: Early field work to begin on Austin's long-awaited light rail project
item.description: Early survey work is expected to begin as part of the multi-billion dollar plan to build Austin's first light rail system.

item.title: One more chilly night before a big warmup
item.description: Temperatures drop tonight before warming back up into the 80s for most of the week. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Texas Lt. Gov. urges DSHS halt renewal of Camp Mystic's license
item.description: Texas Lt. Governor Dan Patrick on Monday issued a letter to the Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) commissioner asking not to renew Camp Mystic’s license pending investigation and that necessary changes are made to ensure lives are not lost at the campsite again.

item.title: Suspect identified in barbershop shooting in Pflugerville
item.description: The Travis County Sheriff's Office (TCSO) has identified Jefferson Josue Rodas as the suspect involved in Friday's shooting at a Pflugerville barbershop near Crystal Bend Drive and Dewberry Drive.

item.title: Former Texan in Puerto Vallarta: 'Black smoke just covering the whole city' from cartel violence
item.description: Paul Kirkpatrick lives in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico, which erupted into cartel retaliation violence on Sunday after the Mexican army killed cartel leader El Mencho.
